Who's behind the numbers

meetMahmoud Salama

I'm an e-commerce performance marketer: media buyer first, with an eye on the whole funnel. I've run Meta and TikTok ads for fashion labels, watch stores and e-commerce platforms, and I've worked on the other side too: finance, shipping and manufacturing.

So when I look at your account, I'm not asking how many people saw the ad. I'm asking how many orders arrived, and how much you kept.

Orders, not clicksEvery campaign is judged by sales, not reach.
Profit, not vanityShipping, returns and margin are part of the plan.

Case 01Shopify storeQ4 2025 → Q1 2026

Before: 4,229 orders a quarter. After: 10,400.

Before
Oct–Dec 2025: 4,229 orders, EGP 1.87M in sales and a 2.72% conversion rate from 141.6K sessions.
What changed
A testing-to-scaling system: test campaigns to find winning products and creatives, CBO campaigns to scale them, dynamic remarketing for visitors, and a seasonal push for Ramadan.
After
Jan–Mar 2026: 10,400 orders, EGP 3.67M in sales and a 3.79% conversion rate from 271.5K sessions. More traffic, and more of it buying.

Case 02E-commerce storeAug → Sep 2024

Before: 2,666 orders a month. After: 8,489.

Before
August 2024: 2,666 orders and EGP 1.43M in sales. The ads brought 2,135 purchases, and order volume was stuck despite significant ad spend.
What changed
New creatives built around what buyers actually responded to, tighter targeting, and budget scaled in steps the algorithm could keep up with.
After
September 2024: 8,489 orders and EGP 4.83M in sales. The ads brought 5,957 purchases, with ROAS steady at about 9.5 on 3× the budget.

Case 03Men's fashion1 product · 5 weeks

One product in a crowded feed. EGP 32 back for every 1.

The problem
Men's fashion is one of the most crowded categories on Meta. The brand had one product and needed volume without burning its margin.
What I did
Tested angles fast, cut losers within days, and pushed the winners. Messages ran beside website sales to catch buyers who wanted to ask first.
The result
3,575 website orders at EGP 18.67 each, about EGP 2.16M in sales on EGP 66,750 of spend.

How I work

the methodFrom audit to scale
in four steps.

No black box. You know what I'm testing, why, and what it costs, every week.

WEEK 1

Audit

I go through your ad account, store, pricing and delivery numbers to find where money leaks before adding any budget.

WEEK 1–2

Test

New creative angles and audiences on small budgets. Clear stop rules, so losing ads die fast and cheap.

WEEK 3+

Scale

Winners get more budget in steps the algorithm can handle, so cost per order holds as volume grows.

EVERY WEEK

Report

A short report in plain language: spend, orders, cost per order, profit, and what happens next.

I read your P&L,
not just your ROAS.

A cheap order that gets returned or loses money on shipping isn't a win. I've worked across e-commerce finance, operations, shipping and manufacturing, so I plan ads around the profit you actually keep.

Questions

before we talkCommon
questions.

Still not sure? Message me on WhatsApp and ask anything. No pitch.

Ask Mahmoud
What budget do I need to start?

There's no fixed minimum. You need enough budget to test a few creatives properly before judging them. After the audit I'll tell you what your products and margins actually need.

How fast will I see results?

The first 1 to 2 weeks are for testing, so you'll see which ads and audiences work. Scaling starts once winners are clear. You get a report every week, so you're never guessing.

Do you make the ad creatives?

I plan the angles, hooks and offers and write the creative brief. Your designer or content creator shoots it, and I decide which versions get budget based on results.

Which platforms do you work on?

Meta (Facebook and Instagram, including message campaigns for WhatsApp and Messenger) and TikTok.

What access do you need?

Partner access to your ad account and Business Manager, your store analytics, and your real order numbers: delivered, returned and refused. The last one matters most, because ads that bring returns aren't wins.

How do you charge?

Usually a monthly management fee. For the right brand, a fixed fee plus a share of profit. It depends on your budget and scope, and we agree on it after the audit, in writing.

Can you guarantee a ROAS?

No honest media buyer can. What I can promise is clear tests, fast decisions, weekly reports, and every decision based on the profit you keep.
